body.title: Portwell votes tonight on the Congestion Charge
body.text:
Portwell’s councillors meet at 7pm to decide whether drivers entering the harbour district should pay a £6 daily Congestion Charge from next April.

Supporters say the fee would raise about £14 million a year — enough to build a tram line between the station and the ferry terminal and to cut bus fares by a third.

Traders on the high street have collected 8,000 signatures against the plan, warning that shoppers will drive to out-of-town retail parks instead.

The vote is expected to be close: of 48 councillors, 23 have said they will back the charge and 21 oppose it.
